theme.en: Know the world with the body and senses: listen, look, touch, talk.
theme.zh: 用身体和感官认识世界：听、看、摸、说。

form.en: Game cards and short videos for parents. No screen for the child.
form.zh: 给家长的亲子游戏卡和短视频，孩子不看屏幕。

theme.en: Look closely, say it clearly, ask why.
theme.zh: 看仔细、说清楚、问为什么。

form.en: Interactive pages, hands-on activities, five minutes a day.
form.zh: 互动页、动手活动、每天 5 分钟。

theme.en: Explain with a model, predict with a pattern.
theme.zh: 用模型解释现象，用规律预测。

form.en: Simulations with sliders, insight videos, varied practice.
form.zh: 可调参数的模拟、洞察视频、变式练习。

theme.en: The inner structure of each subject; argue from evidence.
theme.zh: 学科内部的结构；用证据说话。

form.en: Interactive labs, discussion groups, open problems.
form.zh: 互动实验室、讨论小组、开放题。

theme.en: Many-factor systems; rigorous argument, writing and modelling.
theme.zh: 多因素系统；严谨论证、写作和建模。

form.en: Worked-problem videos, projects, bridges to exams and competitions.
form.zh: 讲题、项目、衔接选考和竞赛。

what.en: Predict before the experiment, the next line, the cause — then look.
what.zh: 实验前先预测，读之前先猜下文，看史料前先猜原因。

what.en: Data in science, sources in history, maps in geography, the text itself in reading.
what.zh: 科学的数据、历史的史料、地理的地图、语文的原文。

what.en: Frames of reference, other people in history, other scales on a map, other ways to say it.
what.zh: 物理的参考系、历史的不同当事人、地理的不同尺度、英语的换种说法。

what.en: Every lesson ends with putting it in your own words.
what.zh: 每课结尾用自己的话讲清楚。

tagline.en: Characters make sense, sentences have a skeleton, and every text is a writer's choices.
tagline.zh: 字是有道理的，句子有骨架，文章是作者选出来的。

what.en: The radical hints the meaning, the phonetic hints the sound: 河, 湖, 海 all carry water.
what.zh: 形旁表义、声旁表音；「河、湖、海」都带水。

what.en: Who + does what + how. Take away the describing words and the sentence still stands.
what.zh: 谁 + 做什么 + 怎么样；去掉修饰，句子还站得住。

name.en: A text is what the writer chose

what.en: What to write, what to leave out, what comes first — all of it is a choice.
what.zh: 写什么、不写什么、先写什么都是选择。

what.en: When you answer 'why', point to the sentence in the text.
what.zh: 回答「为什么」时指出原文哪一句。

what.en: Level and oblique tones, rhyme, pauses: a poem is meant to be read aloud.
what.zh: 平仄、押韵、停顿；诗是读出来的。

1.en: Why does this character look like this?

2.en: Why did the writer write it this way?

3.en: How do you prove your reading?

4.en: Who is this text talking to?

misconceptions.en: Every character is a separate picture you just have to memorise.
misconceptions.zh: 每个字都是一张单独的图，只能死记。

misconceptions.en: A character has only one meaning.
misconceptions.zh: 一个字只有一个意思。

misconceptions.en: Figures of speech are just decoration.
misconceptions.zh: 修辞只是「装饰」。

misconceptions.en: The longer the essay, the better.
misconceptions.zh: 作文越长越好。

title.en: Build a character: meaning part + sound part

insight.en: In a meaning–sound character, the radical tells you the area of meaning and the phonetic hints at the sound: 青 + 氵/日/目/讠/忄 gives 清 晴 睛 请 情.
insight.zh: 形声字里，形旁告诉你意思跟什么有关，声旁提示读音：青 + 氵/日/目/讠/忄 → 清 晴 睛 请 情。

misconception.en: Every character is a separate picture you just have to memorise.
misconception.zh: 每个字都是一张单独的图，只能死记。

explain.en: A friend says Chinese characters are thousands of unrelated pictures. Use 清 and 晴 to show them why not — then give one case where the sound hint does not work.
explain.zh: 有人说汉字是几千张互不相干的图。用「清」和「晴」跟他讲讲为什么不是——再举一个声旁提示不灵的例子。

home.en: Find five characters with 氵 or 扌 on packets, signs or book covers at home. Guess what each one is about, then check with an adult or a dictionary.
home.zh: 在家里的包装、招牌、书皮上找 5 个带「氵」或「扌」的字，先猜它跟什么有关，再问大人或查字典核对。

insight.en: Remove the describing words and a sentence still stands on 'who + does what (+ what)'; add them back and it says more, not something else.
insight.zh: 去掉修饰词，句子靠「谁 + 做什么（+ 什么）」照样站得住；加回去，句子说得更多，但骨架不变。

misconception.en: Every word in a sentence is equally important.
misconception.zh: 句子里每个词都一样重要。

explain.en: Pick a long sentence from a storybook. Tell someone its skeleton — who does what — and say which words you took off and why the sentence still works.
explain.zh: 从故事书里找一个长句子，说出它的骨架——谁做什么，再讲讲你拿掉了哪些词，为什么句子还通。

home.en: Write a three-word skeleton on a strip of paper (e.g. 小狗 / 追 / 球). Take turns with someone adding one describing word at a time on sticky notes. Who can make it longest while it still makes sense?
home.zh: 在纸条上写一个三块的骨架（比如「小狗 / 追 / 球」），和家人轮流在便利贴上加一个修饰词贴上去。谁能让句子最长、又还说得通？

title.en: Tap the beat of a Tang poem

insight.en: A five-character line is read in beats 2 + 3 (often 2 + 2 + 1 or 2 + 1 + 2) and a seven-character line 4 + 3 (2 + 2 + 3); in 绝句 and 律诗 the rhyme falls at the end of the even-numbered lines, and line 1 may rhyme too.
insight.zh: 五言句一般按「二三」停顿（细分常为二二一或二一二），七言句按「四三」（二二三）；绝句、律诗的韵脚落在双数句末，第一句也可以押韵。

misconception.en: How you read a poem aloud doesn't matter — just read every character at the same speed.
misconception.zh: 诗怎么读都一样，一个字一个字平着念就行。

explain.en: A friend reads 白日依山尽 one character at a time, all at the same speed. Show them where the main pause goes and why. Then tell them which lines of 登鹳雀楼 rhyme and how you can tell.
explain.zh: 同学把「白日依山尽」一字一字、一样快地念。告诉他主停顿在哪里、为什么；再说说《登鹳雀楼》哪几句押韵，你是怎么听出来的。

home.en: Pick a Tang poem you know. Read it to someone at home, clapping once for each beat group, and write a / at each main pause. Do the rhyming characters fall at the end of lines 2 and 4?
home.zh: 挑一首你会背的唐诗，读给家里人听，每个节拍拍一下手，在主停顿处画 /。押韵的字是不是落在第 2、4 句末？

title.en: Reorder and cut: writing is choosing

insight.en: Moving or cutting one paragraph changes what the reader feels first and what they remember; what a writer leaves out is a choice too.
insight.zh: 挪动或删掉一段，读者先感到什么、最后记住什么就变了；不写什么，也是作者的选择。

misconception.en: The longer the essay, the better.
misconception.zh: 作文越长越好。

explain.en: Take an essay you wrote. Find one paragraph that could go without hurting the feeling, and say what the reader would feel first and remember last once it is cut.
explain.zh: 拿出自己写过的一篇作文，找一段「删了也不影响心情」的话，说说删掉以后，读者会先感到什么、最后记住什么。

home.en: Write a small event from your week on four or five slips of paper, one paragraph each. Read it aloud to your family in different orders, then take one slip away. Which order makes them want to hear more?
home.zh: 把这周的一件小事写在四五张纸条上，一张一段。换几种顺序读给家人听，再抽掉一张：哪种排法最让人想往下听？

title.en: How a word's meaning moves through time

insight.en: Meanings drift: in classical Chinese 走 meant 'run' and 去 meant 'leave', so read an old text with the old meaning, and let the context prove it.
insight.zh: 词义会走动：古文里「走」是跑、「去」是离开；读古文要用古义，并用上下文来证明。

misconception.en: A character has only one meaning.
misconception.zh: 一个字只有一个意思。

explain.en: A friend reads 弃甲曳兵而走 as 'they threw off their armour, dragged the soldiers and walked off'. Tell them which two words they read with today's meaning, what the words mean here, and which other words in the sentence prove it.
explain.zh: 同学把「弃甲曳兵而走」讲成「丢掉盔甲，拖着士兵，走开了」。告诉他哪两个字用了今天的意思，在这里应该是什么意思，句子里还有哪几个字能证明。

home.en: Ask an older family member for a word that meant something different when they were young, or look up 走, 去 or 闻 in a dictionary and count how many meanings it lists. Which meaning is listed first, and why?
home.zh: 问问家里长辈：有没有哪个词，他们小时候的意思和现在不一样？或者翻字典查「走、去、闻」，数数各列了几个意思。排在第一个的是哪个意思，为什么？

title.en: Map an argument: claim, reasons, evidence

insight.en: An argument is a claim held up by reasons, and each reason needs evidence; a reason with nothing under it does not hold the claim up.
insight.zh: 论证 = 观点 + 理由 + 论据；底下没有论据的理由，撑不起观点。

misconception.en: Stating an opinion firmly is already an argument.
misconception.zh: 观点说得够坚定，就算论证了。

explain.en: Pick a short opinion piece or advert. Find its claim, list its reasons, and say which reason has no evidence under it.
explain.zh: 找一篇短评论或一则广告，说出它的观点，列出它的理由，再指出哪条理由底下没有论据。

home.en: Have a friendly debate at dinner (e.g. “we should get a dog”). Write the claim on one sticky note, each reason on another and each piece of evidence on a third colour. Which reasons end up with nothing stuck under them?
home.zh: 饭桌上来一场友好的辩论（比如「我们家该不该养狗」）。观点写在一张便利贴上，每条理由写一张，每条论据用另一种颜色。贴完看看，哪条理由下面空空的？

insight.en: Writers answer earlier writers; set two texts side by side and what the later one keeps, changes or drops shows what it is arguing with.
insight.zh: 作者在回应前人；把两篇放在一起看，后者保留、改动、删掉了什么，就看出它在和谁对话。

misconception.en: A text means only what it says on its own.
misconception.zh: 一篇文章只看它自己就能读懂全部。

explain.en: A friend says, 'Li Bai's Phoenix Terrace just copies Cui Hao.' Answer with evidence: what did Li keep, what did he change, and what do the changes tell you?
explain.zh: 同学说：「李白的《登金陵凤凰台》就是抄崔颢的。」用今天找到的证据回应他：李白保留了什么、改了什么，改动说明了什么？

home.en: Take a song, nursery rhyme or slogan your family knows and find a version that rewrites it (a parody, a cover, an advert). Write both out side by side, mark 同 / 改 / 弃, and say what the rewriter wanted to say.
home.zh: 找一首家里人都熟悉的歌、童谣或广告语，再找一个改编它的版本（仿写、翻唱、段子都行）。并排写下来，标出同、改、弃，说说改编的人想说什么。

title.en: Radical families: what the left side means

insight.en: A meaning radical names a category, often in an older form: 月 in 肚 脸 腿 is flesh (肉), not the moon; 王 in 玩 珠 球 is jade (玉); 衤 is clothing but 礻 is worship.
insight.zh: 形旁标的是一个意义类别，而且常是古字的变形：肚、脸、腿里的「月」是肉，不是月亮；玩、珠、球里的「王」是玉；「衤」管衣服，「礻」管祭祀。

misconception.en: A radical means exactly what it looks like: 月 always means the moon.
misconception.zh: 偏旁长什么样就是什么意思：带「月」的字都跟月亮有关。

explain.en: A friend says 胖 (fat) must have something to do with the moon. Explain why not — and give a character whose 月 really is the moon.
explain.zh: 有人说「胖」一定跟月亮有关。跟他讲讲为什么不是——再举一个「月」真的是月亮的字。

home.en: Find characters with 月, 王 or 衤/礻 on the side in a picture book or on packets. Sort them into body / moon, jade, clothing / gods, then check with an adult or a dictionary.
home.zh: 在绘本或包装上找带「月」「王」「衤/礻」偏旁的字，分成身体/月亮、玉、衣服/神几类，再问大人或查字典核对。

title.en: One character, two sounds: let the sentence decide

insight.en: Many characters have more than one reading, and each reading goes with its own meaning: 长 is cháng in 长江 (long) but zhǎng in 长大 (grow); the words around it tell you which.
insight.zh: 不少字有几个读音，读音跟着意思走：「长江」的长读 cháng（长短），「长大」的长读 zhǎng（生长）；该读哪个，看它前后的词。

misconception.en: Each character has only one sound; once you know it, you can read it everywhere.
misconception.zh: 一个字只有一个读音，认识了就到处都这么读。

explain.en: A friend reads 还 as hái everywhere. Use 还在 and 还给 to show them why that's wrong, and say which word told you each time.
explain.zh: 同学把「还」一律读成 hái。用「还在」和「还给」跟他讲讲为什么不对，再说说每次你是看哪个词判断的。

home.en: Play 'two-sound tag' with someone: one person says a character from this page, the other makes one word for each reading (长: 长短, 长大). One point per correct reading, then swap.
home.zh: 和家人玩「一字两音」：一人说本页的一个字，另一人用它的两个读音各说一个词（长：长短、长大）。说对一个读音得一分，再交换。

title.en: Move a comma, change the meaning

insight.en: Punctuation is part of the meaning: it decides where the pauses fall, who is speaking and what is asked, so the same characters can say opposite things.
insight.zh: 标点也是意思的一部分：它决定在哪里停、谁在说话、是不是在问，同样几个字可以说出相反的意思。

misconception.en: Punctuation is just for pausing to breathe; the words carry all the meaning.
misconception.zh: 标点只是换气用的，意思全在字里。

explain.en: Write 「小林说我画得最好」 for someone, once with 说：“ ” and once without. Ask them who 我 is each time, and explain why it changes.
explain.zh: 把「小林说我画得最好」写给家人看，一次加 说：“ ”，一次不加。问问他们两次的「我」各是谁，再讲讲为什么会变。

home.en: Write a short sentence on paper without punctuation, cut out marks from sticky notes, and take turns placing them. Read each version aloud — who can make it say the opposite?
home.zh: 在纸上写一句不带标点的短句，用便利贴剪出标点，和家人轮流摆。每摆一次读出来——谁能让它说出相反的意思？

title.en: Pick the comparison: what does the reader see?

insight.en: A metaphor lends the reader features of a familiar thing: call the moon a 白玉盘 (jade plate) and they see round and bright, call it a boat and they see a thin curve; choosing what to compare to is choosing what the reader notices.
insight.zh: 比喻是把熟悉事物的特点借给读者：把月亮说成「白玉盘」，读者看见圆和亮；说成小船，读者看见弯弯的一道；选什么来比，就是选读者注意什么。

misconception.en: Figures of speech are just decoration: the plain sentence says the same thing.
misconception.zh: 修辞只是「装饰」，换成大白话意思一样。

explain.en: A friend says “月亮像小船 just means 月亮是弯的 — 比喻 is decoration.” Use what you found to tell them what the boat adds, and what a reader would see if you wrote 白玉盘 instead.
explain.zh: 同学说：「『月亮像小船』就是『月亮是弯的』，比喻只是装饰。」用这页的发现跟他讲讲：小船多给了读者什么？换成「白玉盘」，读者又会看见什么？

home.en: Pick something at home (a lamp, a slipper, a pillow). Think of three things to compare it to and ask someone what each one makes them picture. Which one points at the feature you want noticed?
home.zh: 在家里挑一样东西（台灯、拖鞋、枕头……），给它想三个比喻，问家里人每个比喻让他们想到了什么。哪一个最能让人注意到你想让人注意的那一点？

title.en: Explain a thing: numbers, comparison or analogy

insight.en: Listing numbers makes a fact exact, comparing with something known makes the size graspable, and an analogy makes it vivid but only roughly right; a writer picks the method by what the reader needs.
insight.zh: 列数字让事实准确，作比较让大小能被感到，打比方让东西形象但只是大致；用哪种说明方法，看读者需要什么。

misconception.en: 作比较 (comparing) and 打比方 (analogy) are the same thing: both say one thing is like another.
misconception.zh: 「作比较」和「打比方」是一回事，都是拿一个东西说另一个。

explain.en: Explain to a friend why “the Moon is like a mirror” and “Earth is 3.7 times as wide as the Moon” are different methods. Use the word “how much”.
explain.zh: 跟同学讲讲：「月球像一面镜子」和「地球的直径约是月球的 3.7 倍」为什么是两种不同的方法？用上「差多少」这个词。

home.en: Describe your fridge three ways: measure it (numbers), compare it with something else in the kitchen (comparison), and say what it is like (analogy). Read all three to someone and ask which one helped them most.
home.zh: 用三种方法介绍家里的冰箱：量一量（列数字），跟厨房里别的东西比一比（作比较），再说说它像什么（打比方）。读给家人听，问问哪一句最帮得上忙。

why.en: Your child feels that a rhyme has a beat and that line endings chime, long before knowing the word 押韵.
why.zh: 孩子用手和耳朵感到童谣有节拍、句尾会「对上音」，比学「押韵」这个词早得多。

en: a traditional rhyme you know, such as 小老鼠，上灯台
your hands
zh: 一首你会的传统童谣，比如「小老鼠，上灯台」
两只手

en: Say the rhyme slowly and clap once on every character.
Say it again, clapping together, and stretch the last character of each line.
Next time, stop just before a line's last character and let your child fill it in.
Say the whole line together to check.
Try it fast, then slow, then as a whisper.
zh: 慢慢念一遍童谣，每个字拍一下手。
再念一遍，和孩子一起拍，每句最后一个字拖长一点。
下一遍念到句尾前停住，让孩子把最后一个字接上。
一起把整句念一遍，听听接得对不对。
换着玩：快快念、慢慢念、悄悄念。

guess.en: I'll stop before the end. What sound do you think comes next?
guess.zh: 我念到这里停一下，你猜后面是哪个字？

en: Which two words at the ends sound alike?
Does this rhyme feel happy or sleepy? Why?
Can you clap it on your knees instead?
zh: 句子最后的哪两个字听起来像？
这首童谣听着开心还是想睡觉？为什么？
换成拍膝盖，还拍得对吗？

easier.en: Use only the first two lines, and clap together the whole time.
easier.zh: 只念前两句，从头到尾一起拍。

harder.en: Your child says the rhyme alone while you clap; then swap.
harder.zh: 孩子一个人念，你来拍；再交换。

watch.en: A wrong fill-in that still rhymes means your child is hearing the endings. Smile at the guess, then say the real line.
watch.zh: 孩子接错了但接的字也押韵，说明在听句尾的音了。先为这一猜笑一笑，再一起念原句。

why.en: Guessing before turning the page, and pointing to why, is the first step to reading with evidence.
why.zh: 翻页前先猜、再指着画说为什么，是「读要有证据」最早的样子。

en: any picture book, new to your child if possible
a cosy spot to sit together
zh: 任意一本绘本，最好孩子没看过
一个能挨着坐的舒服地方

en: Look at the cover together and ask what the book might be about.
Read a page or two, then pause with your hand on the corner.
Ask what will happen next, and why they think so.
Turn the page and look together: did it happen?
At the end, ask which picture gave the best clue.
zh: 先一起看封面，问问孩子这本书可能讲什么。
读一两页，手按在书角停一下。
问孩子接下来会发生什么，为什么这么想。
翻过去一起看：真的是这样吗？
读完后问问：哪张画给的提示最有用？

guess.en: Before we turn the page: what do you think happens next?
guess.zh: 先别翻，你猜下一页会怎么样？

en: What in the picture made you think that?
How do you think this character feels? Where can you see it?
If you wrote this book, what would happen instead?
zh: 画里的什么让你这么想？
这个小人现在心里怎么样？从哪里看出来的？
要是你来写这本书，会让它怎么样？

easier.en: Ask only 'What is happening here?' and let your child point.
easier.zh: 只问「这一页在干什么？」，让孩子用手指着说。

harder.en: Ask what the writer left out between two pages, and what might have happened there.
harder.zh: 问问两页之间作者没画出来的事：中间可能发生了什么？

watch.en: Notice when your child points at a detail to back up a guess. Praise the pointing, whether the guess came true or not.
watch.zh: 留意孩子有没有指着画里的细节来说理由。不管猜中没有，都夸这一指。

why.en: Your child finds that the same character turns up again and again around the house, and that its shape looks like what it means.
why.zh: 孩子会发现同一个字在家里到处都有，而且字的样子和意思有关系。

en: food boxes, bottles and old flyers at home
a piece of paper with 口, 人 and 大 written large
zh: 家里的食品盒、瓶子、旧传单
一张纸，上面写大大的「口、人、大」

en: Show the paper. Make each shape with your body: open mouth, a person walking, arms and legs spread wide.
Pick one character and hunt for it on boxes and labels.
When your child finds one, compare it with the paper together.
Say aloud the word it sits in, such as 大米 or 行人.
zh: 拿出纸，用身体摆一摆：张嘴是「口」，迈步走是「人」，张开手脚是「大」。
挑一个字，在盒子、标签上找它。
孩子找到了，一起拿纸对一对，是不是同一个。
把它所在的词念出来，比如「大米」「行人」。

guess.en: Look at this box first: do you think 大 is hiding on it? Now let's check.
guess.zh: 先看看这个盒子：你猜上面有没有「大」？我们来找找。

en: Why do you think 大 looks like a person stretching wide?
Where did you find the most of them?
Is there a character here that looks like 人 but isn't? What's different?
zh: 你觉得「大」为什么像一个人张开手脚？
在哪里找到的最多？
有没有长得像「人」又不是「人」的字？哪里不一样？

easier.en: Hunt for 口 only. Its square shape is easy to spot.
easier.zh: 只找「口」，方方的最好认。

harder.en: Add 日 and 木, and guess what each looks like before you tell them.
harder.zh: 再加上「日」和「木」，先让孩子猜它们像什么，再告诉答案。

watch.en: Mixing up 人 and 入 is a good sign: your child is looking closely at strokes. Compare them side by side and praise the looking.
watch.zh: 把「人」和「入」认混，恰恰说明孩子在细看笔画。把两个字并排比一比，夸孩子看得仔细。

why.en: Your child listens hard, names what they hear, and finds sound words like 哗哗 and 叮当 to say it.
why.zh: 孩子用心听、说出听到了什么，再找「哗哗」「叮当」这样的象声词把它说出来。

en: a cup of water and an empty bowl
a bunch of keys
a sheet of paper
a spoon
zh: 一杯水和一个空碗
一串钥匙
一张纸
一把勺子

en: Your child closes their eyes or turns around.
Make one sound: pour water, shake keys, crumple paper, or tap the spoon on the bowl.
Your child guesses what it was, then turns to look.
Together, find a sound word for it: 哗哗, 叮当, 沙沙, 当当.
Swap roles: your child makes a sound and you guess.
zh: 孩子闭上眼睛，或者背过身去。
你弄出一种声音：倒水、晃钥匙、揉纸，或用勺子敲碗。
孩子先猜是什么，再转过来看。
一起给这个声音找个词：哗哗、叮当、沙沙、当当。
换过来，孩子弄声音，你来猜。

guess.en: Keep your eyes shut. What do you think made that sound?
guess.zh: 眼睛别睁开，你猜是什么在响？

en: How would you say that sound with your mouth?
Which two sounds were hardest to tell apart?
What other things at home go 叮当?
zh: 这个声音用嘴巴学，怎么说？
哪两个声音最难分？
家里还有什么东西会「叮当」响？

easier.en: Use two sounds only, and let your child watch you make each one first.
easier.zh: 只用两种声音，先让孩子看着你弄一遍。

harder.en: Make two sounds one after the other, and ask which came first.
harder.zh: 连着弄两种声音，问孩子哪个先响。

watch.en: Invented sound words are welcome. Making up a word that fits the sound is exactly the skill, so say it back and use it.
watch.zh: 孩子自己编的象声词也很好：给声音配一个像的词，正是要练的本事。跟着说一遍，接着用。

safety.en: You handle the water, keys and any breakable bowl; use a plastic bowl. Wipe up spills so no one slips.
safety.zh: 水、钥匙和易碎的碗由大人拿，碗用塑料的。洒了水马上擦干，免得滑倒。

why.en: Acting out tiny scenes with toys, your child says whole sentences built on 'who + does what', the skeleton every sentence stands on.
why.zh: 用玩具演小场面，孩子说出「谁 + 做什么」的完整句子，这正是每句话的骨架。

en: 2 or 3 large soft toys
one everyday object, such as a cup or a ball
zh: 2–3 个大一点的毛绒玩具
一样日常东西，比如杯子或球

en: Make a toy do something: the bear drinks from the cup.
Say it plainly: 小熊喝水.
Your child makes a toy do something and tells you who did what.
Add one describing word together: 小熊大口喝水.
zh: 让一个玩具做件事：小熊拿杯子喝水。
用一句话说出来：「小熊喝水。」
轮到孩子让玩具做件事，说出谁做了什么。
一起加一个词：「小熊大口喝水。」

guess.en: Watch the bunny. What do you think it's about to do? Now watch.
guess.zh: 看着小兔，你猜它要干什么？好，看它做。

en: Who did it, and what did they do?
If the ball did it instead, how would you say it?
Can you tell me the whole story from the start?
zh: 是谁做的？做了什么？
要是换成球来做，这句话怎么说？
能把刚才的事从头讲给我听吗？

easier.en: You act, your child only names who it was: 'the bear!'
easier.zh: 你来演，孩子只说是谁：「小熊！」

harder.en: String two actions together: the bear drinks, then the bunny falls asleep.
harder.zh: 连着做两件事：小熊喝完水，小兔睡着了。

watch.en: If your child says only 'drinks!', simply echo the full sentence back. No need to correct; hearing it is enough.
watch.zh: 孩子只说「喝水！」时，你把整句接着说一遍就好，不用纠正，听多了自然会说。

safety.en: Avoid toys with small loose parts, like button eyes, for children who still put things in their mouths.
safety.zh: 孩子还爱往嘴里放东西的话，别用纽扣眼睛这类会掉小零件的玩具。

tagline.en: Letters are sounds, words come in parts, and word order carries meaning.
tagline.zh: 字母是声音，词能拆成块，语序本身就是意思。

what.en: Phonics: c-a-t blends into cat; one sound can have several spellings.
what.zh: 自然拼读：c-a-t 拼出 cat；同一个音有几种写法。

what.en: un-happy-ness: roots, prefixes and suffixes.
what.zh: un-happy-ness：词根和词缀。

what.en: Subject–verb–object cannot be shuffled, adjectives have an order; it is not word-for-word Chinese.
what.zh: 主谓宾不能乱，形容词有顺序；不是逐字翻中文。

what.en: Comprehensible input: when you know almost all the words and can follow the story, keep listening instead of stopping for every unknown word.
what.zh: 可理解输入：绝大多数词认识、能跟上情节，就继续听，不为每个生词停下来。

name.en: One meaning, many ways to say it
name.zh: 同一个意思有很多说法

what.en: Paraphrase and register: formal and casual.
what.zh: 换说法、语域（正式 / 口语）。

2.en: Can this word be taken apart?

3.en: Why is this structure used here?
3.zh: 为什么这里用这个结构？

4.en: How do I say it accurately and appropriately?

misconceptions.en: Every English word matches exactly one Chinese word.
misconceptions.zh: 一个英文词对一个中文词。

misconceptions.en: Grammar rules must be memorised before you can use them.
misconceptions.zh: 语法要先背规则再用。

misconceptions.en: If your accent isn't perfect, you shouldn't speak.
misconceptions.zh: 口音不标准就不该开口。

misconceptions.en: Every English word has to be memorised by its shape.
misconceptions.zh: 每个英文单词都只能靠死记字形。

title.en: Change one letter, get a new word
title.zh: 换一个字母，变一个新词

insight.en: Letters stand for sounds; blend the sounds and you can read a word you have never seen.
insight.zh: 字母代表声音；把声音拼起来，没见过的词也能读出来。

misconception.en: Every English word has to be memorised by its shape.
misconception.zh: 每个英文单词都只能靠死记字形。

explain.en: A friend says English words can only be memorised one by one, like pictures. Use three letters to show them why that isn't true.
explain.zh: 朋友说英文单词只能一个个死记字形。用三个字母给他演示一下为什么不是这样。

home.en: Write c, a and t on three paper cards, plus spare cards with other letters. Take turns swapping one card and reading the new word aloud — real or nonsense.
home.zh: 在三张纸卡上写 c、a、t，再多写几张别的字母。轮流换掉一张卡，把新词读出来——真词、假词都算。

insight.en: The same sound can be written in more than one way: rain, play and cake share one vowel sound, and position helps choose — ay usually ends a word, ai sits inside.
insight.zh: 同一个音可以有几种写法：rain、play、cake 里是同一个元音；位置能帮你选——ay 通常在词尾，ai 在词里面。

misconception.en: Each sound has only one spelling.
misconception.zh: 一个音只有一种写法。

explain.en: A friend writes "plai" and "rayn". Using what you counted, explain which spelling goes where — and why both look possible.
explain.zh: 朋友写成了 "plai" 和 "rayn"。用你数出来的结果，跟他讲讲哪种写法放在哪儿——以及为什么两种看起来都像对的。

home.en: Make three paper bins labelled ai, ay and a_e. Hunt for long a words in a picture book and drop a slip with each word in the right bin. Which bin fills fastest?
home.zh: 做三个纸桶，分别写 ai、ay、a_e。在绘本里找读长音 a 的词，每找到一个就写在纸条上放进对应的桶。哪个桶装得最快？

insight.en: A long word is often a root with parts added: prefixes change the meaning (un- = not, re- = again), suffixes mostly change the word class (-ness → noun, -ful/-less → adjective, -ly → adverb).
insight.zh: 长单词常常是词根加零件：前缀改意思（un- 是「不」，re- 是「再」），后缀多半改词性（-ness 变名词，-ful/-less 变形容词，-ly 变副词）。

misconception.en: Long words are hard because each one must be learnt as a whole.
misconception.zh: 长单词难，因为每个都得整个背下来。

explain.en: A friend says long English words must be memorised letter by letter. Take carelessness and show them how to read it from its parts.
explain.zh: 朋友说英语长单词只能一个字母一个字母地背。拿 carelessness 给他演示一下，怎样从零件读出它的意思。

home.en: Write un-, re-, -ful, -less, -ness and -ly on sticky notes. Find root words in a book (help, kind, play…), stick the parts on, say the new word, and check a dictionary: is it real?
home.zh: 把 un-、re-、-ful、-less、-ness、-ly 写在便利贴上。从书里找词根（help、kind、play……），贴上零件读出新词，再查词典：它是真词吗？

insight.en: A tense marks where an action sits in time relative to now; English changes the verb (its form or its helping verb), while Chinese keeps the verb and adds words like 了, 正在 or 会.
insight.zh: 时态标出动作相对「现在」在时间上的位置；英语改动词（词形或助动词），中文动词不变，靠加「了」「正在」「会」这样的词。

misconception.en: Time is shown only by words like yesterday, just as in Chinese.
misconception.zh: 时间只靠 yesterday 这类词表示，跟中文一样。

explain.en: A friend writes “Yesterday I go to the park.” Draw a timeline with now on it and use it to explain why the verb has to change, even though “yesterday” is already there.
explain.zh: 同学写了 Yesterday I go to the park. 画一条标着「现在」的时间轴，用它给他讲清楚：句子里已经有 yesterday 了，为什么动词还要变。

home.en: Stretch a string across the room and clip a card saying NOW in the middle. Clip action cards on it (eat breakfast, see a film…) and say each one aloud with the right verb form. Move a card and say it again.
home.zh: 在屋里拉一根绳子，中间夹一张写着 NOW 的卡片。把动作卡（eat breakfast、see a film……）夹到绳子上，用对的动词形式大声说出来。挪一挪卡片，再说一遍。

insight.en: Knowing most of the words is enough to follow a story; the unknown ones often explain themselves from context.
insight.zh: 认识大部分词就能跟上故事，生词常常能从上下文猜出来。

misconception.en: If you miss one word, you have not understood.
misconception.zh: 漏掉一个词就等于没听懂。

explain.en: Tell someone about a time you understood an English story, song or video without knowing every word. Which words did you skip, and what helped you guess them?
explain.zh: 跟别人讲一次你没认全每个词、却看懂了一个英文故事、一首歌或一段视频的经历。你跳过了哪些词？是什么帮你猜出了它们？

home.en: Listen to a short English story or cartoon once without stopping. Write down 3 words you didn't know and a guess for each from context. Then check them in a dictionary: how many guesses were close?
home.zh: 找一个英文短故事或动画，从头到尾听一遍，中间不停。写下 3 个不认识的词，各写一个你从上下文猜的意思。再查词典：猜得接近的有几个？

title.en: The skeleton of a long sentence

insight.en: Strip away the clauses and phrases and a long sentence still stands on its subject and main verb (and object); find the main verb first.
insight.zh: 去掉从句和短语，长句子仍然靠主语和谓语动词（和宾语）立着；先找谓语动词。

misconception.en: Long sentences are read by translating word by word from left to right.
misconception.zh: 长句子要从左到右逐词翻译着读。

explain.en: Take a long sentence from something you read in English. Show a friend how you find its main verb, then its subject, then where each chunk hangs — and why the first verb you meet is often not the main one.
explain.zh: 从你读的英文材料里找一个长句，给同学演示：先找谓语动词，再找主语，再看每个挂件挂在哪个词上；再讲讲为什么遇到的第一个动词往往不是谓语。

home.en: Copy a long English sentence onto a strip of paper and cut it into chunks. Put the chunks aside one by one until only the skeleton is left, and read it aloud. Then swap sentences with someone.
home.zh: 把一个英语长句抄在纸条上，用剪刀剪成一块块挂件，一块一块拿开，直到只剩骨架，把它读出来。再和家人交换句子试试。

insight.en: The same meaning can be said formally or casually; the right choice depends on who you are talking to and why.
insight.zh: 同一个意思可以说得正式或随意，怎么选看你在跟谁说话、为了什么。

misconception.en: There is one correct way to say each thing — and the more formal, the better.
misconception.zh: 每件事只有一种正确说法，而且越正式越好。

explain.en: Write the same short request (e.g. borrowing a book) three times: to a close friend, to a teacher, to a library. Explain what you changed each time and why the most formal version is not the “best” one.
explain.zh: 把同一个小请求（比如借一本书）用英语写三遍：给好朋友、给老师、给图书馆。讲讲每次改了什么，为什么最正式的那版不是「最好」的。

home.en: Collect three real English messages you received this week (a text, a school notice, an advert email). Underline contractions, phrasal verbs and passives, and guess who wrote each one for whom.
home.zh: 找三条这周收到的英文消息（短信、学校通知、广告邮件），划出缩写、短语动词和被动语态，猜猜每条是谁写给谁的。

insight.en: The ending -s is said three ways, chosen by the word's last sound, not its last letter: /s/ after a quiet sound (cats), /z/ after a buzzing sound (dogs), /ɪz/ after a hissing sound (buses) — and the same rule works for he runs and Tom's.
insight.zh: 词尾 -s 有三种读法，看的是单词最后一个「音」而不是最后一个字母：清音后读 /s/（cats），浊音后读 /z/（dogs），嘶嘶音后读 /ɪz/（buses）；he runs、Tom's 也按同一条规则。

misconception.en: The ending -s is always pronounced /s/.
misconception.zh: 词尾的 -s 一律读 /s/。

explain.en: A friend says “bed-s” with a hissing /s/. Using your throat test, explain why beds ends in /z/ — and why cakes still ends in /s/ even though cake ends in a buzzing-looking letter e.
explain.zh: 朋友把 beds 读成带嘶声的 /s/。用摸喉咙的办法跟他讲讲为什么 beds 结尾读 /z/——再讲讲 cake 最后一个字母是 e，为什么 cakes 还是读 /s/。

home.en: Hand on throat, say ten plural things in your room (socks, pens, boxes…). Sort them into three piles of paper slips: quiet /s/, buzz /z/, extra syllable /ɪz/. Which pile is biggest?
home.zh: 手放在喉咙上，说出房间里十样东西的复数（socks、pens、boxes……）。写在纸条上分三堆：不振 /s/、振 /z/、多一个音节 /ɪz/。哪一堆最多？

insight.en: A Chinese word and an English word cover different patches of meaning: 开 is open the door, turn on the light, drive a car and hold a meeting, so learn a word together with the words it goes with.
insight.zh: 中文词和英文词覆盖的意思范围不一样：「开」可以是 open the door、turn on the light、drive a car、hold a meeting，所以学词要连着它的搭配一起学。

misconception.en: Every English word matches exactly one Chinese word.
misconception.zh: 一个英文词对一个中文词。

explain.en: A friend says "Please open the TV." Explain why that sounds wrong in English and what to say instead. Then think of another Chinese word with more than one English match.
explain.zh: 朋友说 "Please open the TV."。跟他讲讲为什么英语里听着不对，应该怎么说。再想一个中文词，它在英语里不止一个对应。

home.en: Walk around your home and point at things you 开: the door, the fridge, the tap, the lamp, the computer. Say the English for each. Which ones are open and which are turn on?
home.zh: 在家里走一圈，指着能「开」的东西：门、冰箱、水龙头、台灯、电脑。每样说出英语。哪些是 open，哪些是 turn on？

title.en: Can you count it in English?

insight.en: English sorts nouns into countable and uncountable as a grammar label, not by whether the thing can really be counted: chairs but furniture, suggestions but advice; uncountable nouns take no a or -s and use much, some or a container word (a piece of advice).
insight.zh: 英语把名词分成可数和不可数，这是语法标签，不看东西实际能不能数：chairs 可数而 furniture 不可数，suggestions 可数而 advice 不可数；不可数名词不加 a、不加 -s，用 much、some 或量词短语（a piece of advice）。

misconception.en: If you can count the things in real life, the English noun is countable, so “furnitures” and “advices” are fine.
misconception.zh: 现实中能一个个数的东西，英语里就是可数名词，所以可以说 furnitures、advices。

explain.en: A friend writes “I need some advices and two furnitures.” Explain why it is wrong — real advice can be counted, so what decides it? — and fix both.
explain.zh: 朋友写了 “I need some advices and two furnitures.” 说说错在哪——建议明明能一条条数，那到底由什么决定？——再把两处都改对。

home.en: Pick six things at home (spoons, rice, books, water, shoes, sugar). Guess countable or not, then check a learner's dictionary for [C] or [U]. Which guesses were wrong?
home.zh: 在家里找六样东西（勺子、米、书、水、鞋、糖），先猜英语里可数不可数，再查学习词典里标的 [C] 还是 [U]。哪些猜错了？

insight.en: When several adjectives stand before a noun they follow a usual order — opinion, size, age, shape, colour, origin, material, purpose — so a lovely big old wooden table sounds right and an old wooden big lovely table does not.
insight.zh: 几个形容词一起放在名词前，有一个惯常顺序——观点、大小、新旧、形状、颜色、来源、材料、用途——所以 a lovely big old wooden table 听着顺，an old wooden big lovely table 就别扭。

misconception.en: Adjectives in front of a noun can go in any order.
misconception.zh: 名词前的形容词怎么排都行。

explain.en: A friend says “a wooden old lovely table”. Without just saying “it sounds wrong”, explain which words are in the wrong place and why — using the ladder.
explain.zh: 同学说成了 “a wooden old lovely table”。不要只说「听着不对」，用这把梯子给他讲清楚：哪几个词放错了位置，为什么。

home.en: Pick an object at home and write three adjectives for it on separate slips of paper (e.g. small, old, metal). Shuffle the slips, then lay them out in the usual order in front of the object’s name and read it aloud. Swap objects with someone.
home.zh: 在家里挑一样东西，给它想三个英文形容词，分别写在小纸条上（比如 small、old、metal）。把纸条打乱，再按惯常顺序摆在这样东西的英文名字前面，读出来。和家人交换东西再试。

insight.en: In English one syllable of a word is stressed — longer, louder, higher — and moving it can change the word: in many two-syllable pairs the noun is stressed first (a REcord) and the verb second (to reCORD).
insight.zh: 英语单词里有一个音节要重读（更长、更响、更高），挪动重音能改变这个词：许多双音节词里，名词重音在前（a REcord），动词重音在后（to reCORD）。

misconception.en: Every syllable in an English word gets equal weight, like characters in Chinese, so stress doesn't matter if the sounds are right.
misconception.zh: 英语单词的每个音节一样重，像汉字一个字一拍，只要音发对，重音无所谓。

explain.en: A friend says the stress in an English word doesn't matter as long as each sound is right. Use "present" in one sentence to show them why it does.
explain.zh: 朋友说英语单词只要每个音发对，重音无所谓。用 present 造一句话，给他演示为什么重音有关系。

home.en: Clap the beats of a word: one big clap for the stressed syllable, one small clap for the other. Clap "a PREsent" and "to preSENT", then try record, object and rebel.
home.zh: 给单词拍节拍：重读音节拍一下大的，另一个拍一下小的。拍拍 a PREsent 和 to preSENT，再试 record、object、rebel。

why.en: Your child picks up English words for the body by touching each part as it is sung, with no translating needed.
why.zh: 边唱边摸，孩子不用翻译，就把身体部位的英文词和自己的身体连在一起。

en: your bodies
a little space to stand up
zh: 你和孩子的身体
一块能站起来的空地

en: Say the words slowly, touching each part: head, shoulders, knees, toes, eyes, ears, mouth, nose.
Sing the traditional rhyme: "Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes." Touch as you sing.
Finish with: "And eyes and ears and mouth and nose."
Sing it again a little faster, then very slowly.
Leave one word out, just touch the part, and see if your child fills it in.
zh: 先慢慢说一遍，边说边摸：head、shoulders、knees、toes、eyes、ears、mouth、nose。读音提示：head 的 d 轻轻收住，不要读成「黑的」；knees 的 k 不发音，结尾是轻轻的 z 音。
唱这首传统儿歌："Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes." 唱到哪个词就摸哪里。
最后一句是："And eyes and ears and mouth and nose."
再唱一遍，快一点；再来一遍，特别慢。
故意不唱某个词，只用手去摸，看孩子会不会自己补上。

guess.en: I'm going to stop before the next word. Where do you think my hands go next? Touch it, then we'll sing and check.
guess.zh: 下一个词我先不唱。你猜我的手要去哪儿？先摸摸看，再一起唱，看对不对。

en: Which word is the funniest to say?
Can you touch your knees and your nose at the same time?
Shall we sing it super slow or super fast?
zh: 哪个英文词说起来最好玩？
你能同时摸到 knees 和 nose 吗？
咱们唱超级慢的，还是超级快的？

easier.en: Use only the first line and just four words: head, shoulders, knees, toes.
easier.zh: 只唱第一句，只用 head、shoulders、knees、toes 四个词。

harder.en: Let your child lead and change the speed, or add new parts like hands, feet and tummy.
harder.zh: 让孩子来带唱、来定快慢，或者加新部位：hands、feet、tummy。

watch.en: Your child may touch the right part long before saying the word. That is understanding, and it comes first. Your own accent is fine: what matters is that you have a go together.
watch.zh: 孩子往往先会摸对，过很久才会说出来。摸对就是听懂了，听懂本来就在说之前。你的口音不标准也没关系，重要的是一起开口唱。

why.en: Your child learns to follow short English commands with their whole body, so the words mean actions, not Chinese words.
why.zh: 孩子用整个身体听懂简短的英文指令，这些词直接就是动作，不用先变成中文。

en: a teddy or any soft toy
a clear patch of floor
zh: 一只小熊或任何毛绒玩具
一块空出来的地面

en: Show each action as you say it: jump, clap, sit down, stand up, turn around, stop.
Hold up the teddy and say: "Teddy says jump!" Both of you jump.
Give a few more "Teddy says…" commands, doing them together.
Now sometimes leave out "Teddy says". If you just say "Clap!", nobody claps.
Swap: your child holds the teddy and gives the commands.
zh: 边说边做示范：jump（跳）、clap（拍手）、sit down（坐下）、stand up（站起来）、turn around（转一圈）、stop（停）。读音提示：clap 的 cl 连起来一口气读，不要读成「克拉普」。
举起小熊说："Teddy says jump!"，你和孩子一起跳。
再说几个 "Teddy says…"，一起做。
然后偶尔不说 "Teddy says"，只说 "Clap!"——这时谁都不许拍。
换过来，孩子拿着小熊发指令，你来做。

guess.en: Listen carefully: did Teddy say it? Guess, move or freeze, then we'll check what I said.
guess.zh: 仔细听：是小熊说的吗？先猜，动还是不动，然后我们再看看我刚才到底怎么说的。

en: Which action do you like best?
How did you know when not to move?
What should Teddy make me do next?
zh: 你最喜欢哪个动作？
你是怎么知道这次不能动的？
接下来让小熊叫我做什么？

easier.en: Skip the trick round and use only three actions: jump, clap, stop.
easier.zh: 先不玩「没说小熊说」那一轮，只用 jump、clap、stop 三个动作。

harder.en: Join two actions: "Teddy says clap and jump!" or add numbers: "Jump three times!"
harder.zh: 两个动作连起来："Teddy says clap and jump!"，或者加数字："Jump three times!"

watch.en: Moving by mistake is part of the fun, so laugh about it together. Watch for your child acting on the English word before you show the action: that is listening for meaning.
watch.zh: 做错动作本来就是这个游戏的乐趣，一起笑一笑就好。留意孩子是不是不等你示范、一听到英文词就动起来——这就是在听意思了。

why.en: Your child hears that animals "speak" differently in English, a first taste that one thing can be said in more than one way.
why.zh: 孩子会发现，同一只小狗，英语里叫声和中文不一样——第一次体会「同一个意思有不同的说法」。

en: toy animals or pictures of animals from any picture book
zh: 玩具小动物，或任何绘本里的动物图片

en: Hold up each animal and say its English sound: dog "woof", cat "meow", cow "moo", duck "quack".
Ask your child how the dog barks in Chinese, then how it barks in English.
Sing the traditional rhyme: "Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O."
Add: "And on that farm he had a cow… with a moo moo here." Your child makes the sound.
Let your child choose the next animal for the song.
zh: 一只一只拿出来，说英文叫声：狗 woof、猫 meow、牛 moo、鸭子 quack。读音提示：woof 嘴唇先收圆，结尾 f 是上牙轻碰下唇吹气；quack 结尾 k 短短收住，后面不加「e」音。
问孩子：小狗中文怎么叫？英语里又是怎么叫的？
唱这首传统儿歌："Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O."（E-I-E-I-O 就是念这三个字母的名字：E、I、E、I、O）
接着唱："And on that farm he had a cow… with a moo moo here."，叫声让孩子来。
下一段唱什么动物，让孩子来挑。

guess.en: Before I say it: how do you think a duck says it in English? Have a try, then listen.
guess.zh: 我先不说：你猜鸭子在英语里怎么叫？先学一声，再听我说。

en: Does the English dog sound like the Chinese dog?
Which animal sound is the silliest?
What sound would a sheep make, do you think?
zh: 英语里的小狗和中文里的小狗，叫得一样吗？
哪个动物叫得最好笑？
你猜小羊会怎么叫？

easier.en: Use only two animals, dog and cat, and make the sounds together.
easier.zh: 只用两只动物：狗和猫，一起叫。

harder.en: Add sheep "baa", pig "oink" and hen "cluck", and let your child sing a whole verse.
harder.zh: 加上 sheep "baa"、pig "oink"、hen "cluck"，让孩子自己唱完一段。

watch.en: Notice if your child is surprised that the sounds differ; that surprise is the point. Don't ask which one is "right": both are.
watch.zh: 留意孩子听到叫声不一样时有没有吃惊——这份吃惊就是这张卡要的。不用问哪个「对」，两种都对。

why.en: Your child starts to hear that English words begin with a sound, the very first step towards reading letters later.
why.zh: 孩子开始听出英文单词开头有一个「音」，这是以后用字母拼读的第一步。

en: a few safe things around the room, such as a ball, a book, a banana, a cup, a cat toy
zh: 屋里几样安全的东西，比如球、书、香蕉、杯子、玩具猫

en: Name each thing slowly in English: ball, book, banana, cup, cat.
Stretch the first sound: "b-b-b-ball." Say the sound /b/ short, without a vowel.
Say the traditional line: "I spy with my little eye something beginning with b-b-b."
Your child guesses, touches the thing and says its name.
Swap: your child chooses a thing and says the first sound for you.
zh: 用英语慢慢说出每样东西：ball、book、banana、cup、cat。
把开头的音拉长："b-b-b-ball"。读音提示：/b/ 只是嘴唇一碰的短音，不要读成「波」或字母名「比」；/k/ 是喉咙里轻轻一顶，不要读成「克」。
说这句传统游戏词："I spy with my little eye something beginning with b-b-b."
孩子猜是哪样，跑过去摸一摸，说出它的英文名字。
换过来，孩子挑一样东西，说出开头的音让你猜。

guess.en: Which thing starts with b-b-b? Point at your guess first, then we'll say its name slowly and listen.
guess.zh: 哪样东西是 b-b-b 开头的？先指一个你猜的，再一起慢慢说它的名字，听听对不对。

en: Do ball and book start the same way?
What does cup start with? Is it like cat?
Can you find something else that starts with b-b-b?
zh: ball 和 book 开头的音一样吗？
cup 是什么音开头的？和 cat 像不像？
你还能找到别的 b-b-b 开头的东西吗？

easier.en: Put just two things in front of your child, one starting with b and one with c.
easier.zh: 只在孩子面前摆两样：一个 b 开头，一个 c 开头。

harder.en: Add a third sound, like m for mug and milk, and play with things all over the room.
harder.zh: 加第三个音，比如 m（mug、milk），在整个屋子里找。

watch.en: This card is about hearing, not letters, so no need to write anything. If a guess starts with a different sound, just say both names slowly and let your child hear the difference.
watch.zh: 这张卡练的是耳朵，不是字母，不用写字。孩子猜的东西开头音不对，就把两个名字都慢慢说一遍，让孩子自己听出不同。

safety.en: Use only things that are safe to hold. Leave out coins, buttons, batteries, small magnets and anything sharp.
safety.zh: 只用拿在手里安全的东西。硬币、纽扣、电池、小磁铁和尖利的东西都不要用。

why.en: Your child learns in, on and under by moving a toy, and hears that English puts the place word first, "on the box".
why.zh: 孩子挪着玩具学会 in、on、under，也会听到英语把方位词放在前面：on the box，而中文说「盒子上」。

en: a big soft toy
a box or basket
a chair or table
zh: 一个大的毛绒玩具
一个盒子或篮子
一把椅子或一张桌子

en: Move the toy as you say: "in the box", "on the box", "under the chair".
Give your child the toy and say: "Put Teddy in the box."
Try "on the box" and "under the chair". Show it the first time if needed.
Mix them up and speed up, then let your child give the orders.
Hide the toy while your child looks away. Your child finds it and says where it was.
zh: 边挪玩具边说："in the box"（盒子里）、"on the box"（盒子上）、"under the chair"（椅子下）。读音提示：the 的 th 是舌尖轻轻放在牙齿间，读不准就读得轻一点、快一点，没关系。
把玩具交给孩子，说："Put Teddy in the box."
再试 "on the box" 和 "under the chair"，第一次可以先做给孩子看。
打乱顺序、越说越快，然后让孩子来发指令。
孩子转过身，你把玩具藏好。孩子找到后，说说它在哪儿。

guess.en: I've hidden Teddy. Guess where first: in, on or under? Then go and look.
guess.zh: 小熊藏好了。先猜：in、on 还是 under？然后去找找看。

en: Where would you like to hide Teddy?
Can you put Teddy under the box? Now on it?
Can you tell me where Teddy is, in English or Chinese?
zh: 你想把小熊藏在哪儿？
能把小熊放到盒子下面吗？再放到上面呢？
你来告诉我小熊在哪儿，英语、中文都行。

easier.en: Use only in and on, with one box.
easier.zh: 只用 in 和 on，只用一个盒子。

harder.en: Add "next to" and "behind", and let your child give you two orders in a row.
harder.zh: 加上 "next to"（旁边）和 "behind"（后面），让孩子一次给你两个指令。

watch.en: Your child might answer with one word, "under!", or point. That is a full answer at this age. Repeat it back in a whole phrase, "Yes, under the chair", without asking them to repeat it.
watch.zh: 孩子可能只答一个词 "under!"，或者直接用手指——这个年龄这就是完整的回答。你用整句说一遍："Yes, under the chair"，不用让孩子跟着重复。

safety.en: Use a big toy, not small figures, if a child under 3 is nearby. Keep the box away from stairs and don't let your child climb inside it.
safety.zh: 家里有 3 岁以下的孩子时，用大玩具，别用小人偶。盒子不要放在楼梯边，也别让孩子爬进去。

tagline.en: Predict, test fairly, explain with things you cannot see.
tagline.zh: 先预测，再公平地试，用看不见的东西解释看得见的现象。

name.en: Everything is made of tiny particles
name.zh: 世界由看不见的小颗粒组成

what.en: Sugar in water has not vanished; a smell is particles drifting to you.
what.zh: 糖溶进水里没有消失；气味是飘过来的颗粒。

name.en: Things don't start moving by themselves
name.zh: 东西不会无缘无故动起来

what.en: A push starts it; without a push it slows — friction is pulling on it.
what.zh: 推一下才动，不推会慢慢停——是摩擦在拉它。

name.en: Energy changes form but is never made or lost
name.zh: 能量会换样子，但不会凭空来去

what.en: Battery → light → heat; food → running.
what.zh: 电池 → 灯光 → 热；食物 → 跑步。

name.en: Living things survive by their structure

what.en: The shape of a beak, leaves turning to the light.
what.zh: 鸟喙的形状，叶子朝着光。

name.en: Change one thing, watch one thing
name.zh: 变一个、看一个、其余不动

what.en: A fair test changes one variable and keeps the rest the same.
what.zh: 公平实验只改一个条件，其余保持一样。

name.en: Big and small, fast and slow

what.en: From a grain of sand to a mountain; from a second to ten thousand years.
what.zh: 从一粒沙到一座山，从一秒到一万年。

1.en: How do we make the test fair?

2.en: How do we explain what we cannot see?
2.zh: 看不见的东西怎么解释？

misconceptions.en: Heavy things sink, light things float.
misconceptions.zh: 重的沉，轻的浮。

misconceptions.en: Sugar disappears when it dissolves.
misconceptions.zh: 糖溶解后就没有了。

misconceptions.en: It is cold in winter because Earth is farther from the Sun.
misconceptions.zh: 冬天冷是因为地球离太阳远。

insight.en: Whether something floats depends on how heavy it is for its size, not on how heavy it is.
insight.zh: 沉浮不看多重，看「同样大小时谁更重」。

misconception.en: Heavy things sink, light things float.
misconception.zh: 重的沉，轻的浮。

explain.en: A big log floats but a small nail sinks. Explain why to a friend without using the word 'heavy'.
explain.zh: 大木头能浮，小铁钉却沉。不用「重」这个字，给朋友讲讲为什么。

home.en: Fill a bowl with water. Test an apple, a coin, a lump of clay, then the same clay pressed into a boat shape.
home.zh: 装一盆水，试试苹果、硬币、一团橡皮泥，再把同一团橡皮泥捏成小船。

insight.en: A shadow is where light is blocked, so it always points away from the light; moving the light changes the shadow's direction and length.
insight.zh: 影子是光被挡住的地方，所以总在背着光的那一边；灯一动，影子的方向和长短就跟着变。

misconception.en: A shadow is a reflection of the object.
misconception.zh: 影子是物体的倒影。

explain.en: A friend says a shadow is a picture of you, like a reflection. Use two lights to show them it is not.
explain.zh: 朋友说影子是你的像，就像倒影。用两盏灯给他看看，为什么不是。

home.en: In a dark room, shine a torch at a toy from the side, then from high up. Try two torches at once. Outside, mark a stick's shadow with chalk at 9:00, 12:00 and 15:00.
home.zh: 在暗房间里，用手电筒从旁边、再从高处照一个玩具；再试两支手电筒一起照。到户外，在 9 点、12 点、15 点用粉笔画下一根木棍的影子。

title.en: Solid, liquid, gas: the same particles

insight.en: Heating does not change the particles, only how fast they move and how far apart they are.
insight.zh: 加热不改变颗粒本身，只改变它们动得多快、离得多远。

misconception.en: Particles of ice are colder and harder than particles of water.
misconception.zh: 冰的颗粒比水的颗粒更冷、更硬。

explain.en: A friend says ice is cold because its particles are cold. Using the words “move” and “apart”, explain what really differs between ice and water.
explain.zh: 朋友说冰之所以冷，是因为冰的颗粒是冷的。用上「动」和「离开」这两个词，讲讲冰和水真正的区别。

home.en: Fill a cup with ice and a little cold water. Stir and read a kitchen thermometer every minute: it stays near 0 °C until the last ice has melted, even though the room keeps adding heat.
home.zh: 杯子里放满冰，加一点冷水。搅一搅，每分钟用厨房温度计读一次：直到最后一块冰化完，温度都停在 0 °C 附近，虽然屋子一直在给它加热。

insight.en: Weight times distance must match on both sides; a longer arm needs less weight.
insight.zh: 两边「重量 × 距离」要相等，力臂越长，用的力越小。

misconception.en: A balance only balances when the weights are equal.
misconception.zh: 两边一样重才会平衡。

explain.en: A child and a grown-up on a seesaw: where should each sit so it balances? Explain with weight × distance, not just ‘heavier’.
explain.zh: 小孩和大人坐跷跷板，各坐哪儿才能平衡？用「重量 × 距离」讲给别人听，别只说「谁更重」。

home.en: Balance a ruler on a round pencil at its middle. Put 2 coins 3 cm from the pencil on one side. Where must 1 coin go on the other side? Then try 3 coins.
home.zh: 把一把尺子的中间架在圆铅笔上放平。一边离铅笔 3 厘米放 2 枚硬币，另一边 1 枚硬币要放在哪儿？再试试 3 枚。

title.en: Who eats whom, and where the energy goes

insight.en: Each step up a food chain passes on only about a tenth of the energy; the rest is used for living and lost as heat.
insight.zh: 食物链每往上一级，只传上去大约十分之一的能量，其余用来活着、变成热散掉。

misconception.en: Predators are at the top because they are strongest.
misconception.zh: 猛兽在顶端是因为它们最强。

explain.en: A field has thousands of grasshoppers but only a few hawks. Explain why to a friend without using the words ‘strong’ or ‘weak’.
explain.zh: 田野里蚱蜢成千上万，鹰却只有几只。不用「强」「弱」这两个字，给朋友讲讲为什么。

home.en: Count out 100 grains of rice for the grass. Pass a tenth to a ‘grasshopper’ cup, then a tenth of that to a ‘frog’ cup. What is left for a snake? Then look in a park or garden: who eats whom?
home.zh: 数 100 粒米当作草。把十分之一放进「蚱蜢」杯，再把它的十分之一放进「青蛙」杯。还剩多少给蛇？再去公园或花园看看：谁吃谁？

title.en: Light the bulb: why it needs a loop
title.zh: 点亮小灯泡：为什么要接成一圈

insight.en: A bulb lights only when there is an unbroken loop from one end of the battery, through the bulb, and back to the other end.
insight.zh: 只有从电池一头出发、穿过灯泡、再回到电池另一头，连成不断的一圈，灯泡才会亮。

misconception.en: One wire from the battery to the bulb is enough to light it.
misconception.zh: 从电池拉一根线到灯泡，灯就能亮。

explain.en: A friend says one wire from the battery should light the bulb. Use your finger to trace the path and show them where it stops.
explain.zh: 朋友说从电池拉一根线到灯泡就能亮。用手指沿着电走的路画一画，让他看看电在哪里走不下去。

home.en: With a grown-up, use one 1.5 V battery, a small torch bulb and two wires with bare ends. Light it, then add a gap and test a spoon, foil, a pencil lead and a rubber band. Only small batteries: never wall sockets.
home.zh: 请大人陪着，用一节 1.5 伏电池、一个手电筒小灯泡和两根两头露铜的电线。先点亮它，再留个缺口，试试勺子、锡纸、铅笔芯和橡皮筋。只用小电池，千万不要碰墙上的插座。

insight.en: Every sound comes from something vibrating, and the vibration needs air, water or a solid to travel through; faster vibrations sound higher.
insight.zh: 声音都来自物体的振动，振动要靠空气、水或固体传过来；振得越快，声音越高。

misconception.en: Louder sounds are higher, and sound can travel through empty space.
misconception.zh: 声音越响就越高；声音在真空里也能传。

explain.en: A friend says hitting a drum harder makes the note higher. Use the drum and the ruler to show them what really makes a note higher.
explain.zh: 朋友说用力敲鼓，音就会变高。用鼓和尺子给他看看，到底什么才让音变高。

home.en: Hold a ruler on a table with part of it sticking out, and twang it. Make the part shorter: what happens to the note? Twang harder: what changes? Then put your ear on the table while someone scratches the far end softly.
home.zh: 把尺子压在桌边，让一部分伸出去，弹一下。把伸出去的部分变短，音怎么变？用力弹，什么变了？再把耳朵贴在桌面上，请别人在桌子另一头轻轻刮。

insight.en: Dissolved sugar breaks into particles too small to see, spread through the water; the scale shows the total weight does not change.
insight.zh: 溶解的糖散成看不见的小颗粒，分布在水里；秤上的总重量一点没变。

misconception.en: Sugar disappears when it dissolves.
misconception.zh: 糖溶解后就没有了。

explain.en: A friend says the sugar disappeared because you can’t see it any more. Use the scale reading and the word “particles” to explain where the sugar went, and how you could get it back.
explain.zh: 朋友说：糖看不见了，所以糖没有了。用秤上的读数和「颗粒」这个词，讲讲糖去了哪里，又怎样把它取回来。

home.en: Put a glass of water on a kitchen scale and note the reading. Add two spoons of sugar and note it again. Stir until it dissolves: the reading stays the same. Taste a sip. Then leave a little on a saucer in a warm place for a few days and look for sugar crystals.
home.zh: 把一杯水放在厨房秤上，记下读数；放两勺糖，再记一次。搅到糖溶解：读数不变。尝一口。再倒一点在小碟子里，放在暖和的地方几天，找一找糖的晶体。

title.en: Can a coat keep ice cold?

insight.en: A coat does not make heat; it slows heat moving across it — so it keeps a warm body warm and a cold ice cube cold.
insight.zh: 大衣自己不产生热，它只是让热量穿过得更慢——所以它让暖的身体保暖，也让冰块保冷。

misconception.en: A coat is warm by itself, so wrapping ice in a coat will make it melt faster.
misconception.zh: 大衣本身是热的，所以用大衣包着冰块，冰会化得更快。

explain.en: Your friend says: “Don’t put the ice in a coat, the coat will warm it up!” Use the words “heat flows” and “slows down” to explain why the ice in the coat lasts longer, and why the same coat keeps you warm in winter.
explain.zh: 朋友说：「别把冰放进大衣里，大衣会把它捂化的！」用「热流动」和「变慢」这两个词，讲讲为什么包在大衣里的冰反而撑得更久，又为什么同一件大衣冬天能让你暖和。

home.en: Take two ice cubes the same size. Put one on a plate; wrap the other in a wool scarf or sock on another plate. Check every 15 minutes which is smaller. If you have a thermometer, push it into a folded coat that has been in the room for an hour: it reads room temperature.
home.zh: 拿两块一样大的冰。一块放在盘子上；另一块用羊毛围巾或袜子包起来，放在另一个盘子上。每 15 分钟看一次哪块更小。有温度计的话，把它插进在房间里放了一小时、叠好的大衣里：读数就是室温。

title.en: Why does the Moon change shape?

insight.en: Half of the Moon is always lit by the Sun; as the Moon goes round Earth in about a month, we see different amounts of that lit half.
insight.zh: 月球总有一半被太阳照亮；它大约一个月绕地球一圈，我们看到的亮面多少就跟着变。

misconception.en: The Moon's phases are Earth's shadow falling on the Moon.
misconception.zh: 月相是地球的影子挡在月亮上造成的。

explain.en: A friend says the crescent Moon is Earth's shadow. Use the first-quarter Moon (where are the Sun, Earth and Moon?) to change their mind.
explain.zh: 朋友说月牙是地球的影子挡出来的。用上弦月（太阳、地球、月球各在哪里？）说服他。

home.en: In a dark room with one lamp on one side, hold a ball at arm's length and turn slowly on the spot. Watch the lit part of the ball grow and shrink — your head is Earth. Bonus: draw the Moon each evening for two weeks.
home.zh: 暗房间里只在一边开一盏灯，伸直手臂举一个球，原地慢慢转一圈。看球上亮的部分怎样变大又变小——你的头就是地球。加分：连续两周，每天傍晚画一次月亮。

why.en: Your child learns to make a guess about each object, then let the water give the answer.
why.zh: 孩子先猜每样东西会沉还是会浮，再让水来告诉答案。

en: a large bowl or basin of water
a towel
6–8 things to test: a spoon, an apple, a cork, a key, a plastic lid, a ball of foil
zh: 一大盆水
一条毛巾
6–8 样要试的东西：勺子、苹果、软木塞、钥匙、塑料瓶盖、一团锡纸

en: Lay the objects on the towel next to the bowl of water.
Pick one up together. Your child says: will it sink or float?
Put it in the water gently and watch what happens.
Sort the tested things into a sink pile and a float pile.
Squash the foil ball flat or shape it into a boat, and test it again.
zh: 把东西摆在水盆旁边的毛巾上。
一起拿起一样，让孩子先说：它会沉还是会浮？
轻轻放进水里，看看到底怎样。
试过的分成两堆：沉的一堆，浮的一堆。
把那团锡纸压扁，或捏成小船，再放进去试一次。

guess.en: Before it goes in: do you think it will sink or float? Let's put it in and see.
guess.zh: 先别放，你猜它会沉下去还是浮起来？好，放进去看看。

en: Did anything surprise you?
The apple is big but it floats. What do you think about that?
Can you find something at home that might float? Let's try it.
zh: 哪一样跟你猜的不一样？
苹果那么大，怎么浮起来了？你怎么想？
家里还有什么可能会浮？去找来试试。

easier.en: Test only three things with very clear answers, such as a key, a cork and a spoon.
easier.zh: 只试三样结果很明显的，比如钥匙、软木塞和勺子。

harder.en: Put one small and one big thing of the same material side by side, such as two keys or two wooden blocks.
harder.zh: 找同一种材料的一大一小两样，比如两把钥匙、两块木头，一起试。

watch.en: Many children say big things sink and small things float. Don't correct the guess; let the water show it. Praise the guess, right or wrong.
watch.zh: 很多孩子觉得大的会沉、小的会浮。不用纠正，让水来回答。不管猜对猜错，都夸孩子敢猜。

safety.en: Stay right next to your child the whole time around water, even a shallow bowl. Keep small objects like keys and corks away from children who still put things in their mouths.
safety.zh: 玩水时大人全程守在旁边，浅盆也一样。孩子还爱往嘴里放东西的话，钥匙、软木塞这类小东西要看好。

why.en: Your child finds out that a shadow appears where light is blocked, and that moving the light changes it.
why.zh: 孩子会发现：光被挡住的地方就有影子，灯一动，影子也跟着变。

en: a torch
a plain wall or a sheet of white paper
a toy figure or a cup
zh: 一支手电筒
一面白墙或一张白纸
一个小玩偶或杯子

en: Darken the room a little and stand the toy between the torch and the wall.
Switch on the torch and look at the toy's shadow together.
Move the torch closer to the toy, then farther away.
Shine the torch from the left, then from the right.
Let your child hold the torch and make shadows with their hands.
zh: 把房间调暗一点，玩偶放在手电筒和墙中间。
打开手电筒，一起看看玩偶的影子。
把手电筒慢慢靠近玩偶，再慢慢拿远。
从左边照，再换到右边照。
让孩子拿手电筒，用自己的手做影子。

guess.en: If I bring the torch closer, will the shadow get bigger or smaller? Let's try.
guess.zh: 手电筒再靠近一点，你猜影子会变大还是变小？我们试试。

en: Where is the shadow when the light is on this side?
Can you make the toy's shadow disappear?
Why does a shadow have no colour, even when the toy does?
zh: 光从这边照过来，影子跑到哪边去了？
你能让玩偶的影子不见吗？
玩偶是彩色的，影子怎么是黑的？

easier.en: Only move the torch closer and farther; leave the side-to-side part for another day.
easier.zh: 只玩手电筒近一点、远一点，左右换方向留到下次。

harder.en: On a sunny day, go outside in the morning and again after lunch. Look at where your own shadow points.
harder.zh: 晴天上午出门看一次，午饭后再看一次，看看自己的影子朝哪边。

watch.en: Notice whether your child moves the light or the toy to change the shadow. Both are good experiments. Ask what they think will happen before each move.
watch.zh: 留意孩子是动灯还是动玩偶来改影子，两种都是好实验。每动一下之前，问问孩子觉得会怎样。

safety.en: Use a torch, not a hot lamp, and remind your child not to shine it into anyone's eyes. Never look straight at the Sun when you go outside.
safety.zh: 用手电筒，不用会发烫的台灯；提醒孩子别照别人的眼睛。到户外看影子时，千万不要直视太阳。

why.en: Your child sees a dry seed come to life over days, and notices the root goes down and the shoot goes up.
why.zh: 孩子会看到一颗干豆子几天里活过来，还会发现根往下长，芽往上长。

en: a clear glass jar or cup
kitchen paper or cotton wool
a few dry mung beans
water
zh: 一个透明玻璃杯或罐子
厨房纸或棉花
几颗干绿豆
水

en: Line the inside of the jar with damp kitchen paper.
Push three or four beans between the paper and the glass, so you can see them.
Put the jar by a window and keep the paper damp, not soaking.
Look at the beans together each morning for about a week.
zh: 把湿的厨房纸贴着罐子内壁围一圈。
在纸和玻璃中间塞三四颗绿豆，从外面看得见。
罐子放在窗边，保持纸湿润，但别泡在水里。
接下来一周左右，每天早上一起看一看。

guess.en: What do you think the bean will look like tomorrow? Let's check in the morning.
guess.zh: 你猜明天这颗豆子会变成什么样？明早我们来看。

en: What came out of the bean first?
Which way is the root growing? Which way is the shoot growing?
What do you think the bean needs to keep growing?
zh: 豆子先冒出来的是什么？
根往哪边长？芽往哪边长？
你觉得豆子还需要什么才能接着长？

easier.en: Just look and talk each day: is it bigger? Skip the questions about roots.
easier.zh: 每天就看看、说说：是不是变大了？根和芽的问题先不问。

harder.en: Start a second jar in a dark cupboard and compare the two after five days.
harder.zh: 再做一罐放进黑柜子里，五天后和窗边那罐比一比。

watch.en: Waiting is part of science. Let your child draw the bean each day; looking back at the drawings shows how much it changed.
watch.zh: 等待也是科学的一部分。让孩子每天画一画豆子，回头翻一翻，就能看出它变了多少。

safety.en: Dry beans are a choking hazard for young children; hand out a few at a time and put the rest away. Use mung beans, and don't let your child eat the beans or sprouts from the jar.
safety.zh: 干豆子对小孩子有窒息风险，一次只给几颗，其余收好。用绿豆来种，罐子里的豆子和豆芽都别让孩子吃。

why.en: Your child discovers that a magnet pulls some things without touching them, and that only some materials stick.
why.zh: 孩子会发现：磁铁不用碰到也能把东西拉过来，而且只有一些东西会被吸住。

en: one large fridge magnet or toy magnet wand, bigger than a matchbox
a tray of things to test: a spoon, a key, a paper clip, a coin, a crayon, a sock
zh: 一块大的冰箱贴或玩具磁铁棒（比火柴盒大）
一盘要试的东西：勺子、钥匙、回形针、硬币、蜡笔、袜子

en: Lay the objects on the tray in a row.
For each one, your child guesses: will the magnet pick it up?
Hold the magnet close and see if it sticks.
Make a stick pile and a no-stick pile.
Walk around the room with the magnet and test the fridge, a door and a table leg.
zh: 把东西在盘子里排成一排。
每一样都让孩子先猜：磁铁能把它吸起来吗？
拿磁铁靠近，看看吸不吸。
分成两堆：吸住的一堆，吸不住的一堆。
拿着磁铁在屋里走一圈，试试冰箱门、房门和桌腿。

guess.en: Will the magnet pick up the spoon? Say yes or no first, then we'll try.
guess.zh: 磁铁能吸起这把勺子吗？先说能还是不能，再试。

en: What is the same about the things that stuck?
Can the magnet pull the paper clip through a sheet of paper?
Were any metal things not picked up? Which ones?
zh: 吸住的那些东西，有什么地方一样？
隔着一张纸，磁铁还能拉动回形针吗？
有没有金属的东西没被吸住？是哪几样？

easier.en: Use only four things: two that stick and two that clearly don't, like a sock and a crayon.
easier.zh: 只用四样：两样会被吸住，两样明显不会，比如袜子和蜡笔。

harder.en: Put a paper clip on a paper plate and move the magnet underneath to steer it around.
harder.zh: 把回形针放在纸盘上，磁铁在盘子下面移动，让回形针跟着走。

watch.en: Many children expect every metal thing to stick. Coins are a good surprise: some stick and some don't, depending on what they are made of. Let the test settle it, and praise the guess.
watch.zh: 很多孩子以为金属都会被吸住。硬币是个好惊喜：有的吸得住，有的吸不住，要看是什么材料做的。让实验来定答案，夸孩子先猜了。

safety.en: Use only one large magnet that cannot fit in a mouth. Never use small, button or strong (neodymium) magnets: two swallowed magnets can pull together inside the body and cause serious harm. If you think a magnet was swallowed, get medical help at once. Keep coins and paper clips under close watch, and put everything away after play.
safety.zh: 只用一块放不进嘴里的大磁铁。绝对不要用小磁铁、纽扣磁铁或强力磁铁（钕磁铁）：吞下两颗磁铁会在肚子里互相吸住，造成严重伤害。怀疑孩子吞了磁铁，立刻就医。硬币、回形针也要看紧，玩完全部收好。

why.en: Your child sees that ice turns into water, not into nothing, and that warmth makes it happen faster.
why.zh: 孩子会看到冰变成了水，没有消失；越暖和，化得越快。

en: 3 ice cubes of the same size
3 small plates
a warm spot, such as a sunny windowsill
zh: 3 块一样大的冰块
3 个小盘子
一个暖和的地方，比如有太阳的窗台

en: Put one ice cube on each plate.
Leave one in a cool spot, one in a warm spot, and let your child hold one in their hand.
Check all three every few minutes. Which is smallest?
When the ice is gone, look at what is left on each plate.
zh: 每个盘子放一块冰。
一块放在阴凉处，一块放在暖和处，第三块让孩子握在手里。
每隔几分钟看一看三块冰，哪块最小？
冰化完了，看看每个盘子里剩下了什么。

guess.en: Which ice cube do you think will melt first? Point to it, and we'll watch.
guess.zh: 你猜哪块冰最先化完？指一指，我们来看。

en: Where did the ice go?
Why did the one in your hand melt so fast?
Can we turn the water back into ice? How?
zh: 冰跑到哪里去了？
你手里那块为什么化得那么快？
盘子里的水还能变回冰吗？怎么变？

easier.en: Use just two ice cubes: one in the sun and one in the shade.
easier.zh: 只用两块冰：一块晒太阳，一块放阴凉处。

harder.en: Put the water from one plate back in the freezer, and check it the next morning.
harder.zh: 把一个盘子里的水倒回冰格，放进冰箱，第二天早上看看。

watch.en: If your child says the ice disappeared, point to the puddle and ask where it came from. Holding ice is cold, so let them stop whenever they like.
watch.zh: 孩子要是说冰没了，就指指盘子里的水，问问它是从哪来的。握冰很冰手，孩子想放下就放下。

safety.en: Ice cubes can be a choking hazard for young children, so keep them on the plates and out of mouths. Wipe up water on the floor so nobody slips.
safety.zh: 冰块对小孩子有窒息风险，放在盘子里，别让孩子含进嘴里。地上洒了水要及时擦干，免得滑倒。

tagline.en: Forces change motion, energy is kept, and it all depends on where you stand.
tagline.zh: 力改变运动，能量守恒，看到什么取决于你站在哪里。

name.en: A force changes motion, it does not keep it going
name.zh: 力改变运动，不是维持运动

what.en: Push and the speed changes; stop pushing and only friction or air slows it. F = ma.
what.zh: 推一下速度就变；不推了，是摩擦和空气在让它慢下来。F = ma。

what.en: Count everything before and after: the total stays the same, it only moves between forms and objects.
what.zh: 前后都数清楚：总量不变，只在形式和物体之间转移。

name.en: Fields push and pull across empty space

what.en: Gravity, electric and magnetic forces need no contact; a field says how strong and which way at every point.
what.zh: 重力、电力、磁力不用接触；场告诉你每一点的力有多大、朝哪边。

name.zh: 波带走的是能量，不是东西

what.en: Sound, light and ripples move a pattern along; the medium only wobbles in place.
what.zh: 声、光、水波传的是一种样子；介质只在原地晃。

name.en: Motion depends on who is watching

what.en: Speed and path change with the frame of reference; the laws of physics do not.
what.zh: 速度和轨迹随参考系变，物理规律不变。

3.en: How are force and motion related?

misconceptions.en: Heavy things fall faster.
misconceptions.zh: 重的东西落得快。

misconceptions.en: Motion needs a force to keep it going.
misconceptions.zh: 运动需要力来维持。

misconceptions.en: Current is used up by a bulb.
misconceptions.zh: 电流经过灯泡就被用掉了。

misconceptions.en: In a crash the bigger object pushes harder.
misconceptions.zh: 相撞时大的那个推得更用力。

insight.en: Without air, everything falls with the same acceleration g; differences come from air resistance, which matters more for light, wide objects.
insight.zh: 没有空气时，所有东西都以同样的加速度 g 下落；快慢的差别来自空气阻力，又轻又宽的东西受它影响最大。

misconception.en: Heavier objects fall faster.
misconception.zh: 越重的东西落得越快。

explain.en: A friend says 'heavy things fall faster'. Using the words 'air' and 'mass', explain when they are right and when they are wrong.
explain.zh: 朋友说「重的东西落得快」。用上「空气」和「质量」两个词，讲讲他什么时候对、什么时候错。

home.en: Drop a book and a sheet of paper side by side. Then lay the paper flat on top of the book and drop both. Last, crumple the paper into a ball and race it against the book.
home.zh: 把一本书和一张纸并排放手。再把纸平放在书上面一起丢。最后把纸揉成团，和书比一比谁先落地。

title.en: How far would a cart roll with no friction?
title.zh: 没有摩擦，小车能滑多远？

insight.en: The smoother the floor, the farther the cart rolls; with no friction at all it would never stop.
insight.zh: 地面越光滑，小车滑得越远；完全没有摩擦，它就永远不会停。

misconception.en: A moving thing stops by itself when the push runs out.
misconception.zh: 推力用完了，东西自己就会停。

explain.en: A friend says “the ball stopped because the kick ran out”. Using the word “friction”, explain what really stopped it, and what would happen on perfect ice.
explain.zh: 朋友说「球停下是因为踢的那股劲用完了」。用上「摩擦」这个词，讲讲到底是什么让它停下的；如果在完美的冰面上会怎样。

home.en: Lean a book on a few other books to make a ramp. Roll a toy car or a can down it onto a carpet, then onto a smooth floor. Mark where it stops each time and measure the distances.
home.zh: 把一本书斜靠在几本书上搭个斜面。让玩具车或易拉罐从上面滚下，先滚到地毯上，再滚到光滑的地板上。每次标出停下的位置，量一量距离。

title.en: Is current used up in a bulb?

insight.en: The current is the same all the way round a series loop: a bulb turns energy into light and heat, it does not use up charge. In parallel each branch gets the full battery voltage and the branch currents add up.
insight.zh: 串联电路里各处电流一样大：灯泡把能量变成光和热，并没有用掉电荷。并联时每条支路都分到电池的全部电压，各支路电流相加。

misconception.en: Current is used up by a bulb.
misconception.zh: 电流经过灯泡就被用掉了。

explain.en: A friend says the first bulb after the battery's + end gets the most current, so it shines brightest. Using the words “loop”, “current” and “energy”, explain why bulbs in one series loop are equally bright.
explain.zh: 朋友说：离电池正极最近的灯泡分到的电流最多，所以最亮。用上「一圈」「电流」「能量」三个词，讲讲为什么同一个串联电路里的灯泡一样亮。

home.en: With a school circuit kit (a battery, two small bulbs, wires), connect the bulbs in a line, then side by side, and compare how bright they are. No kit? Notice that switching one lamp off at home does not switch the others off — home lamps are wired in parallel. Never open mains wiring.
home.zh: 如果有学校的电路小套件（电池、两个小灯泡、导线），先把两个灯泡连成一串，再并排连，比比亮度。没有套件？留意家里关掉一盏灯，别的灯并不会灭——家里的灯是并联的。千万不要拆家里的电线。

title.en: Where does a lens put the picture?

insight.en: Rays from one point of the object meet again at one point of the image; move the object closer (but still beyond f) and the image moves away and grows; inside f there is only an upright, magnified virtual image, as in a magnifier.
insight.zh: 物体上一点发出的光，经过透镜又会聚到像上一点；物体靠近（仍在焦点以外），像就远离、变大；进到焦点以内，只能看到正立、放大的虚像，就像放大镜。

misconception.en: Covering half the lens cuts off half the picture.
misconception.zh: 挡住半个透镜，像就少一半。

explain.en: A friend says that if a fly lands on a camera lens, the photo will have a black hole where the fly is. Using the words “every point”, “rays” and “brightness”, explain what really happens.
explain.zh: 朋友说：要是一只苍蝇停在相机镜头上，拍出的照片会在苍蝇那里缺一块黑洞。用上「每一点」「光线」「亮度」三个词，讲讲实际会怎样。

home.en: Hold a magnifying glass between a bright window and a white wall or sheet of paper. Move the paper until the window appears sharp — upside down. Then cover half the glass with your hand and watch. Never look at the Sun through a lens or focus sunlight on anything.
home.zh: 拿放大镜站在明亮的窗户和白墙（或一张白纸）之间，前后移动白纸，直到窗户的像变清晰——它是倒着的。再用手挡住放大镜的一半，看看像怎么变。千万不要透过透镜看太阳，也不要用透镜聚焦阳光。

title.en: A ball dropped on a moving train
title.zh: 在行驶的火车上放手一个球

insight.en: Sideways and downward motion are independent: the passenger sees the ball fall straight down, someone on the platform sees a parabola.
insight.zh: 水平和竖直运动互不干扰：车上的人看球直直落下，站台上的人看到一条抛物线。

misconception.en: A ball dropped in a moving train lands behind you.
misconception.zh: 在行驶的火车里放手，球会落到身后。

explain.en: A friend says a ball dropped in a fast train must fly to the back of the carriage. Use two views, the passenger's and the platform's, to explain where it lands, and say when it really would land behind.
explain.zh: 朋友说：在飞快的火车里松手，球一定会飞到车厢后面。用乘客和站台上的人两个视角，讲讲球落在哪里；再说说什么时候它才真的会落在后面。

home.en: Walk at a steady pace and toss a soft ball straight up, a little above your head. It comes back down into your hand. Now toss it and stop suddenly: where does it come down?
home.zh: 匀速走路，把一个软球竖直向上抛，比头高一点。它会落回你手里。再抛一次，然后突然停下：它落在哪里？

title.zh: 单摆的节拍由什么决定？

insight.en: For small swings the period depends only on the length (T = 2π√(L/g)); height energy and speed energy keep trading places.
insight.zh: 小角度时周期只看摆长（T = 2π√(L/g)）；高度的能量和速度的能量来回互换。

misconception.en: A heavier bob swings slower.
misconception.zh: 摆锤越重，摆得越慢。

explain.en: A grandfather clock runs slow. Should you move the bob up or down the rod, and would a heavier bob help? Explain using T = 2π√(L/g).
explain.zh: 一台落地摆钟走慢了。应该把摆锤沿摆杆往上调还是往下调？换一个更重的摆锤有没有用？用 T = 2π√(L/g) 解释。

home.en: Tie a key to a 1 m string and time 10 swings; repeat with two keys, then with the string 25 cm long. Which change matters, and by how much?
home.zh: 把一把钥匙拴在 1 米长的绳子上，量摆 10 次的时间；换成两把钥匙再量；再把绳子缩短到 25 厘米量一次。哪个改变有影响，影响多大？

title.en: Who pushes harder in a crash?

insight.en: Both carts push each other equally hard for the same time, so the total momentum is the same before and after, even when energy turns into heat.
insight.zh: 两辆车互相推的力一样大、时间一样长，所以碰撞前后总动量不变，哪怕有能量变成了热。

misconception.en: In a crash the bigger object pushes harder.
misconception.zh: 相撞时大的那个推得更用力。

explain.en: A friend says “the truck hit the car harder than the car hit the truck”. Using the words “force”, “time” and “momentum”, explain what is true and why the car’s passengers still feel more.
explain.zh: 朋友说「卡车撞小车的力比小车撞卡车的力大」。用上「力」「时间」「动量」三个词，讲讲哪里说得不对，以及为什么小车里的人还是感觉更猛。

home.en: Hold two equal bathroom scales face to face and push them together with a friend: compare the two readings while you push gently, then hard. Then roll a heavy ball into a light one on a smooth floor and watch which one changes speed more.
home.zh: 拿两台一样的体重秤面对面贴着，和朋友一起往中间推：轻推、重推，各比一次两边的读数。再在光滑地板上让一个重球去撞一个轻球，看哪个的速度变得多。

title.en: Drawing a force you cannot see

insight.en: Field lines leave positive charges and end on negative ones; where they crowd together the force on a test charge is strongest.
insight.zh: 电场线从正电荷出发、到负电荷结束；线越密，试探电荷受的力越大。

misconception.en: Charges only feel a force when they touch.
misconception.zh: 电荷碰到一起才会有力。

explain.en: A friend says a charged balloon can only move a scrap of paper if they touch. Using the words “field”, “line” and “distance”, explain what you would see as the balloon comes closer, and why.
explain.zh: 朋友说：带电的气球只有碰到小纸屑才能让它动。用上「电场」「电场线」「距离」三个词，讲讲气球慢慢靠近时你会看到什么，为什么。

home.en: Rub a balloon on wool or dry hair, then bring it slowly toward tiny bits of tissue paper, or toward a thin stream of tap water. Notice how far away it starts to act, and how much faster the effect grows as it gets closer. Works best on a dry day.
home.zh: 把气球在毛衣或干头发上蹭一蹭，再慢慢靠近一些小纸屑，或者靠近一股细细的自来水流。留意它在多远的地方就开始起作用，越靠近效果涨得有多快。天气干燥时效果最好。

title.en: Why doesn't a bed of nails hurt?
title.zh: 躺在钉床上为什么不疼？

insight.en: What presses in is pressure, force divided by area: the same weight spread over a thousand nails or a wide snowshoe presses a thousand times more gently than on one nail.
insight.zh: 压进去的是压强，也就是力除以面积：同样的体重分摊到一千根钉子或一块宽宽的雪鞋上，比压在一根钉子上轻一千倍。

misconception.en: More nails means more points pushing into you, so it hurts more.
misconception.zh: 钉子越多，扎你的尖就越多，所以越疼。

explain.en: A friend says “a bed of nails must hurt more, because there are more points sticking into you”. Using the words “force”, “area” and “pressure”, explain why it is the other way round.
explain.zh: 朋友说「钉床肯定更疼，因为扎你的尖更多」。用上「力」「面积」「压强」三个词，讲讲为什么恰好反过来。

home.en: Hold a sharpened pencil between your two index fingers, point on one side and flat end on the other, and squeeze gently. Both fingers feel the same force — which one hurts? Then press your fingertip and then your flat palm into soft dough or wet sand with the same push and compare the dents.
home.zh: 用两根食指夹住一支削尖的铅笔，一边是笔尖，一边是平的笔尾，轻轻夹紧。两根手指受的力一样大——哪根疼？再用同样的劲，先用指尖、再用整个手掌按进软面团或湿沙里，比比两个坑。

title.en: How hard does water push up?

insight.en: The upward push equals the weight of the water the object shoves aside; once it is fully under, going deeper does not change it.
insight.zh: 水向上的托力等于物体排开的那部分水的重量；完全没入以后，再往深处沉，托力也不变。

misconception.en: The deeper an object sinks, the harder the water pushes it up.
misconception.zh: 东西沉得越深，水往上托它的力越大。

explain.en: A friend says a submarine gets pushed up harder the deeper it dives. Using the words “water pushed aside” and “volume”, explain what really happens to the push once it is fully under.
explain.zh: 朋友说「潜水艇潜得越深，水往上托它的力越大」。用上「排开的水」和「体积」两个词，讲讲潜艇完全没入以后托力到底怎样。

home.en: Put a bowl of water on a kitchen scale. Hang a stone or an unopened drink can on a thread and lower it in without touching the bowl: the scale rises by as many grams as there are cm³ under water. Go deeper — does the number change?
home.zh: 在厨房秤上放一碗水，用细线吊着一块石头或一罐没开的饮料慢慢放进水里，不碰碗：秤上增加多少克，水下就有多少 cm³。再往深处放，数字会变吗？

title.en: Where is the person in the mirror?

insight.en: A plane mirror's image sits behind the glass, as far behind as you are in front, so to see your whole body you need a mirror half your height, wherever you stand.
insight.zh: 平面镜的像在镜子后面，离镜子和你离镜子一样远；所以想看到全身，只要一面你身高一半的镜子，站多远都一样。

misconception.en: The image is on the surface of the mirror, and stepping back lets you see more of yourself.
misconception.zh: 像就在镜面上；往后退就能在镜子里看到更多的自己。

explain.en: Your little brother walks backwards away from the bathroom mirror to see his shoes in it. Using the words “image”, “behind the mirror” and “halfway”, explain why that does not work and what would.
explain.zh: 弟弟想在浴室镜子里看到自己的鞋，就一直往后退。用上「像」「镜子后面」「一半」三个词，讲讲为什么这样没用，怎样才行。

home.en: Stand in front of a bathroom mirror. With a sticky note or a bit of soap, mark where you see the top of your head and the bottom of your chin. Measure the gap and compare it with your real face. Then step back and look again: does your face still fit between the marks?
home.zh: 站在浴室镜子前，用便利贴或一点肥皂，在镜面上标出你看到的头顶和下巴的位置。量一量两个记号的距离，和你真实的脸比一比。再往后退几步看看：你的脸还卡在两个记号之间吗？

title.en: Does the water travel with the wave?

insight.en: A wave moves a pattern and its energy along while each bit of the medium only moves back and forth or round a small loop in place; its speed is frequency times wavelength, v = fλ.
insight.zh: 波把一种样子和能量往前传，介质的每一小块只在原处来回晃或绕小圈；波速等于频率乘波长，v = fλ。

misconception.en: The water in an ocean wave travels along with the wave.
misconception.zh: 海浪里的水是跟着浪一起往前跑的。

explain.en: A surfer waiting beyond the breaking waves rises and falls as swells pass. Why isn't she carried to the beach, and what changes once she catches a breaking wave?
explain.zh: 冲浪的人在碎浪区外等浪，涌浪经过时她一起一伏。为什么她没有被带到岸边？赶上一个正在破碎的浪后又有什么不同？

home.en: Float a bottle cap in a full bath or sink and make ripples at one end with a finger: does the cap travel to the other end? Then tie a ribbon to the middle of a rope or slinky and send a pulse along it.
home.zh: 在装满水的浴缸或水池里放一个瓶盖，用手指在一头拨出水波：瓶盖会漂到另一头吗？再在绳子或彩虹圈中间系一根丝带，沿着它甩出一个波。

title.en: Which way does the ball fly when the string breaks?

insight.en: Going round a circle needs a force pointing to the centre; take it away and the ball flies off in a straight line along the tangent, not outward and not in a curve.
insight.zh: 绕圈需要一个指向圆心的力；这个力一撤，球就沿切线直直飞出，既不是往外甩，也不会继续拐弯。

misconception.en: A centrifugal force flings the ball outward, or it keeps curving after the string breaks.
misconception.zh: 有一股离心力把球往外甩；或者绳断以后球还会接着拐弯。

explain.en: A friend says the ball flies straight outward when the string snaps, because centrifugal force throws it. Explain where it really goes and why, and why it still ends up farther from the pin.
explain.zh: 朋友说：绳子一断，离心力会把球沿绳子方向往外甩。讲讲球实际往哪里走、为什么；再说说它为什么还是离钉子越来越远。

home.en: Cut a slice out of the rim of a paper plate. Lay it flat and roll a marble fast round the inside of the rim. Where does the marble go when it reaches the gap? Mark the path with flour or a ruler.
home.zh: 把纸盘的边剪掉一段，平放在桌上，让一颗弹珠沿盘边内侧快速滚一圈。滚到缺口时它往哪里走？撒点面粉或者用尺子比一比它的路线。

tagline.en: Count the atoms: substances change, the atoms only regroup.
tagline.zh: 数清原子：物质会变，原子只是换了组合。

name.zh: 原子只重新组合，不会消失

what.en: A reaction regroups atoms into new molecules; each kind keeps its count, so mass is conserved.
what.zh: 反应把原子重新组合成新分子，每种原子个数不变，所以质量守恒。

what.en: The same atoms joined differently make different substances: graphite and diamond are both carbon.
what.zh: 同样的原子连法不同就是不同的物质：石墨和金刚石都是碳。

what.en: Breaking bonds takes energy, making bonds gives it out; the difference is the heat of reaction.
what.zh: 断键要吸收能量，成键会放出能量，两者之差就是反应热。

name.en: Reactions have a speed and a balance point
name.zh: 反应有快慢，也有平衡点

what.en: Particles must collide hard enough to react; forward and backward reactions can run at equal rates.
what.zh: 颗粒要撞得够猛才反应；正反应和逆反应可以一样快，达到平衡。

name.en: The periodic table is a pattern
name.zh: 元素周期表是一张规律图

what.en: Ordered by proton number, elements repeat their behaviour because outer electrons repeat.
what.zh: 按质子数排列，最外层电子周期性重复，元素性质也跟着重复。

3.en: How does one substance turn into another?
3.zh: 物质怎么变成别的物质？

4.en: Why do reactions happen, and how fast?
4.zh: 反应为什么会发生、发生多快？

misconceptions.en: Burning destroys matter; mass is lost in a reaction.
misconceptions.zh: 燃烧把物质烧没了，反应会损失质量。

misconceptions.en: Atoms have the properties of the substance: copper atoms are orange, ice molecules are cold.
misconceptions.zh: 原子带着物质的性质：铜原子是橙色的，冰的分子是冷的。

misconceptions.en: Breaking a chemical bond releases energy.
misconceptions.zh: 断开化学键会放出能量。

misconceptions.en: At equilibrium the reaction has stopped.
misconceptions.zh: 达到平衡时反应就停止了。

misconceptions.en: The periodic table is ordered by atomic mass.
misconceptions.zh: 元素周期表是按原子质量排的。

title.zh: 原子只是重新组合，一个也不少

insight.en: In a reaction atoms regroup into new molecules; the count of each kind of atom, and so the mass, stays the same.
insight.zh: 反应中原子重新组合成新分子；每种原子的个数不变，所以质量也不变。

misconception.en: Burning makes matter disappear; mass is lost in reactions.
misconception.zh: 燃烧让物质消失了，反应会损失质量。

explain.en: A rusty nail weighs more than the same nail before it rusted. Use atoms to explain where the extra mass came from.
explain.zh: 铁钉生锈后比原来重。用原子解释多出来的质量是从哪儿来的。

home.en: Put a spoon of baking soda in a bottle, put vinegar in a balloon and stretch it over the mouth. Weigh, tip the vinegar in, weigh again. Then repeat without the balloon.
home.zh: 瓶里放一勺小苏打，气球里装点醋，套在瓶口。先称，再把醋倒进去，再称。然后不套气球再做一次。

insight.en: Each atom makes a fixed number of bonds, so only certain molecules can be built.
insight.zh: 每种原子能连的键数是固定的，所以只能拼出某些分子。

misconception.en: Atoms can stick together in any number and any way.
misconception.zh: 原子可以随便几个、随便怎么粘在一起。

explain.en: Why can you build H₂O₂ but never H₃O as a neutral molecule? Use the number of bonds each atom makes.
explain.zh: 为什么能拼出 H₂O₂，却拼不出中性的 H₃O 分子？用每种原子能连的键数来解释。

home.en: Use balls of play dough and toothpicks. Give every ball a fixed number of toothpicks: 1 for H, 2 for O, 3 for N, 4 for C. Which molecules can you build with every toothpick joined?
home.zh: 用橡皮泥团和牙签。给每个泥团插固定数量的牙签：H 1 根、O 2 根、N 3 根、C 4 根。所有牙签都要连上，你能拼出哪些分子？

title.zh: 同样的原子，不同的物质

insight.en: Properties come from how atoms are arranged, not from the atoms themselves: graphite and diamond are both pure carbon.
insight.zh: 性质来自原子怎么排列，而不是原子本身：石墨和金刚石都是纯碳。

misconception.en: Atoms have the properties of the substance they make up.
misconception.zh: 原子带着它所组成物质的性质。

explain.en: A friend says diamond is hard because diamond atoms are hard. Use graphite to show why that cannot be right.
explain.zh: 朋友说：金刚石硬，是因为金刚石的原子硬。用石墨说明为什么这说不通。

home.en: Rub a soft pencil (2B or softer) on paper until there is a dark patch, then rub it with your finger. Feel how slippery it is: sheets of carbon sliding off. Then try to scratch glass with the pencil tip (careful): nothing happens.
home.zh: 用软铅笔（2B 或更软）在纸上涂出一块黑，用手指搓一搓，感受它有多滑：那是一层层碳在滑落。再用笔尖去划玻璃（小心）：什么也划不出来。

title.en: pH: every step is ten times

insight.en: Each step down the pH scale means ten times more hydrogen ions.
insight.zh: pH 每降低 1，氢离子浓度就变成 10 倍。

misconception.en: pH 3 is only a little more acidic than pH 4.
misconception.zh: pH 3 只比 pH 4 酸一点点。

explain.en: Normal rain is about pH 5.6. In a lake at pH 4.6, many kinds of fish struggle to survive. Explain to a friend why a change of just 1 is a big deal.
explain.zh: 正常雨水约 pH 5.6。湖水到了 pH 4.6，很多种鱼都难以生存。跟朋友讲讲：为什么只差 1 就是大事？

home.en: With an adult: chop red cabbage, soak it in hot water, let it cool and strain it. Add a spoon of this purple indicator to lemon juice, vinegar, tap water and baking-soda water, then line the cups up by colour and compare with the ruler. Use one clean spoon per cup and never mix cleaning products.
home.zh: 请大人一起：把紫甘蓝切碎，用热水泡，放凉后滤出紫色的汁。各舀一勺加到柠檬汁、白醋、自来水、小苏打水里，按颜色排好队，再和 pH 尺对一对。每杯用干净的勺子，清洁剂不要混在一起。

insight.en: Breaking bonds costs energy and making bonds releases it; a reaction is exothermic when the new bonds are stronger.
insight.zh: 断键吸能、成键放能；新键更牢时，反应就放热。

misconception.en: Breaking a chemical bond releases energy.
misconception.zh: 断开化学键会放出能量。

explain.en: A friend says: “Food gives you energy because the bonds in sugar break and release it.” Use bond energies to explain what really happens.
explain.zh: 朋友说：「食物给你能量，是因为糖里的化学键断开，把能量放了出来。」用键能讲讲真正发生了什么。

home.en: With an adult: measure the temperature of some vinegar, stir in a spoon of baking soda and measure again (it gets a little colder). Then open a disposable hand warmer and feel it heat up. Which reaction makes stronger bonds than it breaks?
home.zh: 请大人一起：量一下白醋的温度，加一勺小苏打搅一搅，再量一次（会稍微变凉）。再拆开一片暖宝宝，摸摸它变热。哪个反应形成的键比断开的更牢？

insight.en: Warming speeds a reaction mainly because many more collisions carry enough energy to react, not just because there are more collisions.
insight.zh: 升温让反应变快，主要是因为够能量的碰撞多了很多，而不只是碰撞次数多了。

misconception.en: Heating speeds a reaction only because particles collide more often.
misconception.zh: 升温变快只是因为颗粒碰得更频繁。
